protocol.independent_m4_status: aligned cfg0 control; not an exact native independent-ensemble reproduction

protocol.mimo_tuple_sampling: four independent compact TRAIN permutations; one full exposure per slot per update

protocol.photo_transition: selected local model AND Adam state; fresh global selector; global-only final
protocol.scientific_status: source preparation; root decision and qualification required
protocol.secondary_pooling: mean member softmax probabilities; same selected logits only
protocol.selector: finite validation NLL; strict improvement; earliest exact tie
